drhp.business: LGB manufactures chains, sprockets and metal-formed parts for automotive applications across two business segments: Transmission (chains, sprockets, tensioners, belts) and Metal Forming (fine blanking for precision sheet metal parts, machined components and wire drawing products, used internally as well as sold to other chain manufacturers and spring steel manufacturers). The Company serves a diversified base of Indian and global OEMs as well as the automotive aftermarket.
drhp.end_markets: Automotive OEMs (Indian and global)|Industrial applications|Automotive aftermarket|Exports (about 30 countries)
drhp.expansion: During FY2025-26, the Company added to its renewable/self-generation power capacity, having installed and commissioned a 7.12 MW windmill and a 15.25 MWp DC rooftop/ground-mounted solar plant during the year. It is now developing a further rooftop solar project (2.6 MWp DC capacity) and a Group Captive Power project (12.5 MWp DC capacity), both targeted for commissioning in FY2026-27.
